_source: Verbatim UI strings from pototype/chrome.jsx + shell.jsx that are NOT nav labels and have NO dict key in i18n-full.json. Transcribed (never invented/re-translated) so they stay out of .tsx source (i18n-guard) and route through the i18n phrase layer tp(): th (the visual-gate language) renders the exact prototype text; en/zh/ar fall back to the Thai key until translation entries land in the SACRED i18n-full.json (BLOCKERS B-039) — same fallback the 15 keyless nav labels and the login screen (B-035) already ship with. Strings that DO have a dict key (common.*/nav.*) are rendered with t() directly and are not duplicated here.
